steps.code:
# Parse the note content into song title and artist pairs.
content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line which is the header "# Songs for Spotify Playlist"
song_lines = [line for line in lines if line and not line.startswith('#')]
songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artist = line.split(' by ', 1)
        songs.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))
    else:
        # If no " by ", treat whole line as title
        songs.append((line.strip(), ''))
print(songs)

            song_artists = [a['name'].strip().lower() for a in song['artists']]

print(f"\nAdded {len(added)} songs, failed {len(failed)}")
